text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Yukino 
Bijin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Yukino Bijin 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The prize has changed to "Paka Puchi"...! 
It was completely different when I saw it 
before.
choice_data_list: Things change pretty fast, after all.
Things change pretty quickly, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh~... The claw machines back home 
haven't changed their prizes once in my 
entire life.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If there's something you want, you have to 
grab it early... is that it?
choice_data_list: Do you want a Paka Petit?
Do you want a Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ain't it adorable! We hardly ever 
saw 'em back home, after all.
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Are ya sure!? Well then, if ya insist... 
I'll take ya up on that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
